prompts.text: What would you hear in ten minutes of quiet that busyness has been keeping at bay?

connections.title: Scheduled empty time
connections.why: Empty time is where what you're avoiding shows up.

connections.title: Practise conscience (Gewissen)
connections.why: The interruption is easy to drown out; leave enough quiet.

prompts.text: What is the relation you keep turning over in your mind — and what is the earliest catchable step?

connections.title: Interrupt the chain from stimulus to ruin
connections.why: The chain starts with turning an object over in the mind.

connections.title: Stop the proliferation (papanca)
connections.why: The turning-over is the proliferation's first gear.

prompts.text: What does overthinking protect you from — and what would deciding today cost?

connections.title: Deliberate well
connections.why: The doctor asks how, never whether; deliberation ends in a conclusion.

connections.title: Recognise the limits of analysis — overthinking can be worse than deciding
connections.why: The stopping point is part of the skill.

prompts.text: What is the value that never touches a Tuesday — and what one action would it ask for?

connections.title: Take committed action — behavior is where values become real
connections.why: The value exists in the doing.

connections.title: Engage in meaning-driven behaviour — act on values
connections.why: Choose one manageable action rather than stopping at the list.

prompts.text: What feeling would pass if you stopped returning to it — and how many revisits today?

connections.title: Learn to let affect pass — feelings are impermanent
connections.why: The retelling is checkable: count the revisits.

connections.title: Do not add to the impression
connections.why: The revisit is usually an addition, not the event.

prompts.text: What would the wise reasoning look like — trained, not fixed?

connections.title: Cultivate wise reasoning — wisdom is a trainable skill, not a fixed trait
connections.why: The trainability is the good news.

connections.title: Let practical wisdom unify the virtues
connections.why: The unification is the training's shape.

prompts.text: What would sympathetic joy be — and whose good fortune could you practice enjoying?

connections.title: Practice sympathetic joy (mudita)
connections.why: The joy in another's joy is a practice, not a mood.

connections.title: Honour friendship in prosperity as well as adversity
connections.why: Being glad is the hard part.

prompts.text: What is the story you're in — and who is telling it?

connections.title: Practise emplotment
connections.why: The plot is the story's spine; you have a hand in it.

connections.title: Practise narrative identity
connections.why: The identity is the narrative, and the narrative is revisable.

prompts.text: What would the thick present hold — and what are you hunting in the point between?

connections.title: Live in a thick present
connections.why: The present you perceive is a duration, not a point.

connections.title: Treat the present moment as the miracle
connections.why: The span is where the miracle lives.

prompts.text: What is the shame about — the act, or the self it seems to indict?

connections.title: Work with shame — it is about the self, not the act
connections.why: The working edge is the distinction.

connections.title: Learn approach behaviours for shame — show up, do not hide
connections.why: The approach is the shame's countermove.

prompts.text: What would you do with the fear's energy if it were preparation and not paralysis?

connections.title: Understand fear's function — it prepares you for threat
connections.why: The preparation is the fear's job description.

connections.title: Cultivate courage
connections.why: Courage is fear's energy, spent well.

prompts.text: What is the word you keep using — and what would each person's cases show it means?

connections.title: Watch words; they are not ideas
connections.why: Ask what each person means and which cases they include.

connections.title: Understand the role of language in thinking — words shape thought
connections.why: The word shapes the thought; check the shape.

prompts.text: What would you do with the last of the day's attention — and what does it deserve?

connections.title: Understand that attention needs recovery — directed attention is a depletable resource
connections.why: The depletion is real; the recovery is earned.

connections.title: Practice the art of resting
connections.why: The art is what the last attention deserves.

prompts.text: What would a secure-base behaviour be — for yourself, and for the people you hold?

connections.title: Learn secure-base behaviour — be a safe place for yourself and others
connections.why: The safety is a behaviour, not a feeling.

connections.title: Practise availability (disponibilité)
connections.why: The availability is the base's other name.

prompts.text: If the panic were a messenger, what would it be repeating — and to whom?

connections.title: Learn to work with panic — panic is fear of fear
connections.why: Panic is fear of fear — the message is about the loop, not the world.

connections.title: Handle anxiety by returning to the present
connections.why: The return to the present breaks the loop.

prompts.text: What is the question you are carrying that deserves a better question?

connections.title: Keep the question alive
connections.why: The aliveness is the practice.

connections.title: Practise the question of being
connections.why: Some questions are the practice, not the obstacle.

prompts.text: What would you give style to — and what would the style reveal?

connections.title: Give style to one's character
connections.why: The style is the character, made deliberate.

connections.title: Repeat with difference — never pure repetition
connections.why: The style is the difference, repeated.

prompts.text: What is the work's grain — and what would respecting it change?

connections.title: Respect the material — work with its grain
connections.why: The material has a grain; the work is with, not against.

connections.title: Do art as experience, not as object
connections.why: The experience is in the working-with.

prompts.text: What would the ceremony do — transform a natural end into an infinite task?

connections.title: The ceremony transforms natural ends into infinite tasks (Deleuze)
connections.why: The transformation is the ceremony's work.

connections.title: Turn maintenance into art
connections.why: The ceremony and the maintenance are cousins.

prompts.text: What would the mourning heart bring to the conflict — and what would reluctance protect?

connections.title: Enter conflict reluctantly — with a mourning heart
connections.why: The reluctance is part of the entering well.

connections.title: If you must fight, grieve — never gloat
connections.why: The grief is the fight's honest cost.

prompts.text: What is the flame you return to — and how few are the returns becoming?

connections.title: Let absorption come from continuity
connections.why: The returns are the earlier stage; work on that.

connections.title: Learn focused attention meditation — concentration on a single object
connections.why: A session full of returns is a session full of practice.

prompts.text: What is worth transmitting — and who is it for?

connections.title: Transmit what you master
connections.why: The transmission is the mastery's completion.

connections.title: Make friendship the load-bearing wall
connections.why: The friendship is often who the transmission is for.

prompts.text: What is the both-and that the either-or is hiding?

connections.title: Practice both-and where you can
connections.why: The both-and is usually available where the either-or is loud.

connections.title: Hold yin and yang together
connections.why: The holding-together is the wisdom's shape.

prompts.text: What would the repair's small signal be — and what would it say that a long speech couldn't?

connections.title: Repair ruptures promptly
connections.why: The small signal, offered early, matters more than the long speech given late.

connections.title: Reconcile quickly — don't let conflict fester
connections.why: The quickly is the promptness's content.

prompts.text: What is the verdict the rough year keeps asking for — and what would weather look like instead?

connections.title: Judge your life as a direction, not a destination
connections.why: Moving-questions make a rough year weather on a road.

connections.title: Take obstacles as information, not verdicts
connections.why: The information is the weather's data.

prompts.text: What is the working hypothesis of you — and what would test it?

connections.title: Treat identity as a working hypothesis
connections.why: The hypothesis is testable; the fixed self is not.

connections.title: Cultivate growth orientation — see self as developable
connections.why: The developable is the hypothesis's growth-curve.

prompts.text: What did the process give you this week that the outcome never could?

connections.title: Value the process over the outcome
connections.why: Writing every morning because you like it, whether or not it sells.

connections.title: Make activities autotelic — worth doing for their own sake
connections.why: The doing still recommends itself with the benefits set aside.

prompts.text: What would the mirror-mind show — and what would it not add?

connections.title: Keep a mirror-mind
connections.why: The mirror reflects without adding; the adding is the diagnosis.

connections.title: Practise phenomenological description
connections.why: Describe before interpreting; the mirror is the description.

prompts.text: What is the rhythm of activity and receptivity — and which half is starved?

connections.title: Ride the rhythm of activity and receptivity
connections.why: The plan needs the pause as much as the press.

connections.title: Practice the art of resting
connections.why: The receptivity is the rest, practiced.

prompts.text: What would the human behind the position say — and could you see them first?

connections.title: See the human behind the position
connections.why: The position is the costume; the human is the wearer.

connections.title: Treat every person as another you
connections.why: The standpoint is the human's address.

prompts.text: What would the returned-to breath carry — and what would it set down?

connections.title: Practice sending and taking on the breath
connections.why: Take in the bad, send out the good; the breath is the carrier.

connections.title: Use the breath to steady attention
connections.why: The steadying is the carrying's other face.

prompts.text: What is the enough — and what would the knowing of it free you for?

connections.title: Know what is enough (zhizu)
connections.why: Enough is a knowable number, not a feeling.

connections.title: Contentment is the greatest wealth
connections.why: The contentment is the knowing, enjoyed.

prompts.text: What would you do if you trusted the mind's trainability — and where would you start?

connections.title: Trust that the mind is trainable
connections.why: The trust is the premise of every practice.

connections.title: Recognise that attention is trainable — it can be cultivated
connections.why: The cultivation is agriculture, not magic.

prompts.text: What is the thing you would regret not beginning — and what is its two-minute version?

connections.title: Number your days; we only borrow our time
connections.why: The arithmetic makes the waiting expensive.

connections.title: Do the great while it is small
connections.why: The sprout is the version you can still pull with two fingers.

prompts.text: What would the inner citadel hold — and what does the storm not reach?

connections.title: Build the inner citadel
connections.why: The citadel is what the storm cannot govern.

connections.title: Remember that nothing can harm you except your own judgement
connections.why: The harm is in the judgement, and the judgement has an address.

prompts.text: What would the community's practice be — and who is practicing with you?

connections.title: Practice in community (sangha)
connections.why: The community is the practice's container.

connections.title: Make friendship the load-bearing wall
connections.why: The wall bears what the practice loads.

prompts.text: What is the emergence you could trust — and what would you stop managing to see it?

connections.title: Trust emergent order
connections.why: The order emerges without the hand.

connections.title: Expect emergence — wholes exceed their parts
connections.why: Treat the rearrangement as something to investigate.

prompts.text: What would the evening's tally of gratitude hold — and what specifics?

connections.title: Bank gratitude for past pleasures, and draw on it in need
connections.why: Keep specific past good things written down.

connections.title: Begin the day with intention; end it with review
connections.why: The review is where the tally is taken.

prompts.text: What would the co-regulation be — and whose presence regulates you?

connections.title: Learn co-regulation — affect is regulated with others, not just within
connections.why: The with-others is the mechanism's half.

connections.title: Learn to give and receive support — social support behaviours
connections.why: The support is the co-regulation's deliberate form.

prompts.text: What is the availability — and what would you be present to?

connections.title: Practise availability (disponibilité)
connections.why: The availability is a practice with an object.

connections.title: Cultivate attentional presence in relationships — attend to others
connections.why: The attending is the availability's content.

prompts.text: What is the contribution beyond yourself — and what does it ask of Tuesday?

connections.title: Contribute beyond yourself
connections.why: The contribution is the meaning's larger room.

connections.title: Take committed action — behavior is where values become real
connections.why: The Tuesday is the behavior's address.

prompts.text: What would the tragic optimism hold — and what would it refuse to call good?

connections.title: Practise tragic optimism
connections.why: The optimism that includes the tragic, not the one that denies it.

connections.title: Practise amor fati
connections.why: The refusal to call the diagnosis good is part of the love.

prompts.text: What is the final principle — and what would never-arriving make possible?

connections.title: Accept the final principle — you never arrive — and that is the good news
connections.why: The road is the good news; arrival isn't the point.

connections.title: Pursue becoming, not arrival
connections.why: The becoming is the arrival's replacement, and better.
